script.problem: It reuses a line from the Prep cards word for word.

terra.problem: The passage says Moses gave the tribes their inheritance east of the Jordan, not that they were already living there.
The passage does not say the Israelites' tent days were behind them. The claim about living in tents in the wilderness also needs a reference outside this passage.
The joke refers to Papa's drawer years without identifying the drawer. Bakers may not know his backstory.
The text says Caleb brought an honest report and the others made the people's hearts melt with fear. It does not describe the others' reports.
The framed-on-the-wall comparison does not fit the action, and speaking about a report 45 years later does not establish whether Caleb stayed quiet in the camp.
Saying Caleb earned the promise by walking adds a reason. Moses said the land would be his inheritance because he wholly followed the LORD.
It calls the baker's choice the 'wrong river,' using 'wrong' about an answer.
Calling the Jordan the wrong river implies a different river is involved. The passage identifies the land by where Caleb had set foot, not by a river.
The passage does not establish that the ground at Gilgal was outside the land on which Caleb had previously set foot.
The closing joke is about Caleb having plenty of years already. Jokes about age are prohibited.
Saying Caleb's plan started with the LORD and not his own strength adds a contrast the text does not make. Caleb mentions both his strength and the LORD's help.
The statement that the Amorites are a people in the Bible is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The statement that the Philistines are a people in the Bible is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage says Caleb mentioned the Anakim and their cities; it does not say he warned Joshua about them.
